command: set -euo pipefail; find tasks/active -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' ! -name README.md -print; rg -n '^(owner|branch|worktree|claimed_at):' tasks/active/*.md; git branch --list main; python3 tools/agents/task_claim.py status --root . --fail-on-stale
command_display: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; find tasks/active -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '"'"'*.md'"'"' ! -name README.md -print; rg -n '"'"'^(owner|branch|worktree|claimed_at):'"'"' tasks/active/*.md; git branch --list main; python3 tools/agents/task_claim.py status --root . --fail-on-stale'
label: drift-active-task
